description:
MOPGA (Make Our Planet Great Again) is France's research programme attracting international scientists to work on climate, earth sciences and the energy transition through doctoral and postdoctoral funding hosted at French institutions. Campus France publishes each year's call — including the application window and eligibility — on the MOPGA page.

Programme Highlights

  • Flagship French programme for climate and energy-transition researchers
  • Doctoral and postdoctoral tracks hosted at leading French institutions
  • Call-specific deadlines announced annually by Campus France
  • Strong integration into French research networks (CNRS, universities, national agencies)

Who Should Apply

Researchers worldwide with projects aligned to climate science, earth system research and energy transition themes at the doctoral or postdoctoral level.

Funding and Costs

MOPGA doctoral contracts and postdoc positions with competitive salaries, per the call conditions each year.

Deadline and How to Apply

Watch the Campus France MOPGA page for the 2027 call announcement and follow the two-step application described there. Key deadline information: Annual call for the 2027 intake — dates announced by Campus France on the MOPGA page.
